findings.title: Water fauna do not translate between probe dumps
findings.evidence: Diffing the two [fauna] dumps in each probe shows every fish and surface-water animal kept identical x/z while airborne controls moved. e1_probe.txt: fishPerch 12/12, fishPike 2/2, duckM 6/6, duckF 3/3, beaver 2/2 and swanWhooper 2/2 all had dxz=0.000; the same diff had dragonflies dxz=0.860-0.906, cranes dxz=1.030-1.140 and buzzard dxz=0.707. e2_probe.txt repeats the same zero movement for all fish/ducks/beavers/swans. e4_probe.txt has fishPerch 12/12, fishPike 2/2, duckM 8/8 and duckF 3/3 all at dxz=0.000. e5_probe.txt has fishPerch 12/12, fishPike 2/2, duckM 6/6, duckF 3/3, beaver 1/1 and swanMute 3/3 all at dxz=0.000. A Node placement audit using distToRiver, riverLevelNear, heightAt, LAKES and LOC.POND_LEVEL found these animals are in the correct water and near the correct y level, so the concrete defect is movement. Code also explains the failure mode: tick() distance-culls every non-air animal and continues before tickWater(), so water behavior state does not advance when outside the 650 m camera radius.
findings.fix_hint: Do not skip simulation for water fauna when render-distance culling hides them. Keep tickWater/timers advancing before the visibility continue, or limit the early continue to land grazers. After that, validate that water animals enter swim state and that x/z changes over a multi-second probe.

findings.title: Flutter butterflies often remain fixed at probe precision
findings.evidence: The air movement controls move in the same probe interval, but flutter butterflies frequently do not move more than 0.05 m in x/z. e1_probe.txt: butterflyW 6/6 and butterflyO 4/4 were unchanged, and butterflyY had 3/4 unchanged with max dxz=0.100. e5_probe.txt: butterflyW 6/6 unchanged, butterflyO 2/4 unchanged, butterflyY 3/4 unchanged. e2/e4 show the same pattern with most butterflies at dxz 0.000-0.141 while dragonflies, swallows, cranes and buzzards translate about 0.7-1.1 m. This is not a height issue: the Node audit found low air fauna y values between ground and ground+20.
findings.fix_hint: Seed flutter insects with nonzero vx/vz and/or add a phase-driven drift around the meadow so they visibly translate at probe precision. Keep the existing altitude clamp, but make horizontal motion deterministic enough that a short validation interval shows movement.
